title: Organizations with a seat at the commission, and other ties
question: Do the organizations whose officers sit on City commissions also show other seats, requested payments or large loans?
finding: 2 organizations have an officer confirmed in a commission seat (rosters). Mercy Housing California also appears in 22 other screen groups; members of Residential Rent Stabilization and Arbitration Board declare it on their Form 700; it paid $25,000 to a ballot committee at an official's request; borrowers tied to it hold $351.5 million of City loans.
how: Each organization in rosters "commissioners who are officers or staff of an organization the City pays" was looked up in sidedoors (commissioner businesses), officials (requested payments) and leaks (loan borrowers), and in every other published row.
limits: Seats are often reserved for people from the field, and serving is permitted; the duty is to step aside from decisions about the organization (recusal notices in sidedoors show some). A payment requested by an official for a ballot committee is permitted and reported. Loans to housing partnerships are expected for an affordable-housing developer.
